name: analysis-review
title_zh: 专挑分析报告里算错数和编证据的审计员
tagline_zh: 别人看结论，它翻草稿纸：逐行核对算术、方法论、证据链。适合发报告前想被泼冷水、又怕同事碍于面子不说实话的你。
tagline_en: Others read conclusions; it checks the scratch paper—line-by-line on arithmetic, method, evidence. For when you.
desc_en: Independently scrutinize an analysis for arithmetic, methodology, evidence, and unsupported claims.
why_zh: 不是泛泛提意见，而是按四类硬伤逐项拆解，每处质疑都指向具体行文或数字，逼你面对自己跳过的步骤。
why_en: Not vague feedback. It dissects four hard failure categories, pinning each objection to a specific line or number, forcing you.
limit_zh: 只审文本分析，不读原始数据文件；只指出问题不给修改稿；对图表和代码逻辑不负责；英文材料效果最佳，中文长文可能误报。
limit_en: Text-only; won't read raw data files. Flags issues, offers no rewrites. Ignores charts/code. Best on English; may misfire on long Chinese texts.
title_en: An auditor that hunts for miscalculations and fabricated.
